reason: The cited lines show only that the tool dispatches to iframeFillTool.execute and that its schema accepts an iframe selector, element selector, and value to fill into an element in an iframe on the page. Filling a page/iframe element with an agent-supplied value establishes a data-delivery action to page content, so SINK is supported. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution, returning non-public data into context, or returning attacker-controllable content.
